workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've checked the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. Here are their common available 30-minute slots for next week (Mon, Nov 16 to Fri, Nov 20), from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern.

Mon: 09:00, 09:30
Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed: 15:00, 15:30
Thu: 10:00, 14:30
Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these times against Elena Soto's and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of them work for all four of us. I will then book the meeting. Alison.
